claim: As of September 6, 2016, Dr. Albright is a member of the U.S. Defense Department's Defense Policy Board.

evidence.quote: Dr. Albright chairs the National Democratic Institute
a member of an advisory body, the U.S. Defense Department’s Defense Policy Board
Press Release · Tuesday, September 6, 2016

notes: The first quote supplies the name only.

claim: Madeleine Albright's father was a diplomat and a strong supporter of democracy in Czechoslovakia.

evidence.quote: Email from Madeleine Albright
My father was a diplomat and a strong supporter of democracy in Czechoslovakia

notes: The email does not name the father.

claim: Becoming a U.S. citizen is the most important thing that ever happened to me.

evidence.quote: Becoming a U.S. citizen is the most important thing that ever happened to me.

notes: Albright's own words in an email published on the Obama White House blog, September 20, 2016.

claim: Madeleine Korbel Albright was raising her three daughters while earning her doctorate degree.

evidence.quote: A Proclamation on the Death of Madeleine Korbel Albright
As the devoted mother of three beloved daughters, she worked tirelessly raising them while earning her doctorate degree

notes: No institution or year given for the doctorate.

claim: Madeleine Korbel Albright was the mother of three daughters.

evidence.quote: A Proclamation on the Death of Madeleine Korbel Albright
As the devoted mother of three beloved daughters
Secretary Albright has three daughters.

notes: Merge albright-2026-10-09: combined duplicate candidates tmp-institutional-F-70 (their supporting quotes copied verbatim into evidence).

claim: The flag of the United States was ordered flown at half-staff until sunset on March 27, 2022 as a mark of respect for former Secretary of State Madeleine Korbel Albright.

evidence.quote: As a mark of respect for former Secretary of State Madeleine Korbel Albright and her life of service to our Nation, I hereby order
that the flag of the United States shall be flown at half-staff
until sunset on March 27, 2022

notes: The proclamation (signed the twenty-third day of March 2022) does not itself state the date or place of death.

claim: Madeleine Albright is the granddaughter of Holocaust victims.

evidence.quote: starting with Madeleine Albright
the granddaughter of Holocaust victims

notes: From President Obama's remarks. The remarks carry a correction note about other wording; it does not concern this passage.

claim: Only in America can a refugee become the Secretary of State.

evidence.quote: And she replied, “Only in America can a refugee become the Secretary of State.”

notes: Albright's reply at a naturalization ceremony, as retold by President Obama on May 29, 2012; not her own transcript.

claim: Madeleine Albright was a young girl raised in the shadow of Nazi aggression in Czechoslovakia.

evidence.quote: that a young girl raised in the shadow of Nazi aggression in Czechoslovakia can rise to the highest diplomatic office in America
By virtue of her life and accomplishments, Madeleine Albright embodies the best of America.

notes: From President Clinton's remarks of December 5, 1996.

claim: The Senate's approval of Madeleine Albright's nomination was swift and unanimous.
